title: The Spire of the Glass Steppe
author: Wendell Vane
blurb: Paloma Hartwell, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
